title: Bloch-regulator Principal Parts of Cyclotomic Iwasawa Pseudomeasures
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $K/\mathbb{Q}_p$ be a finite unramified extension. From a finite presentation by roots of unity of order prime to $p$, we construct a localized Iwasawa pseudomeasure on $\mathbb{Z}_p^\times$. Although the pseudomeasure depends on the chosen presentation, its image modulo bounded measures depends only on the associated Bloch class: it is the Frobenius-depleted Coleman regulator of that class multiplied by a universal half-shifted zeta principal part.
